final_answer:
Three of the 26 high-risk user requirements are not currently verified under the team's definition.

1. **URS-EBR-009 (electronic batch record, control requirement): no verifying test case.** The requirement is satisfied only by CS-EBR-03, and no test case has a VERIFIES link to either URS-EBR-009 or CS-EBR-03. The requirement is therefore untested.

2. **URS-EMS-014 (EMS alarm escalation): stale verification.** Its only verifying test is TC-OQ-EMS-04 (alarm escalation to on-call, SMS and voice). The last passing execution is TX-0070 on SYS-EMS, dated 2026-01-20. CC-26-011 modified the child spec CS-EMS-03 (EMS notification group restructure, paging provider change) and was implemented on 2026-03-16. The passing run predates that change, and no re-execution exists.

3. **URS-INC-004 (door-open alarm): failed on INC-03.** The only verifying test is TC-OQ-INC-04. Its latest execution on INC-03 is TX-0023, dated 2026-02-10, with result FAIL (alarm activated at 142 s). INC-01, INC-02 and INC-04 passed. No later passing run exists on INC-03. The linked deviation DEV-26-011 is closed, but CC-26-019 (door switch replacement, which calls for re-executing TC-OQ-INC-04) is approved but not implemented, so the requirement is still unverified on that unit.

The other 23 high-risk requirements meet the verification rule. One case is worth noting: URS-ULT-001 (performance) is verified through a passing OQ re-execution on FRZ-80-02 dated 2026-04-24, after CC-26-014 was implemented on 2026-04-23. Its PQ run on FRZ-80-02 (2026-02-12) predates that change. The rule requires only one passing, post-change verifying test per unit, so I counted it as verified. Whether a PQ re-run is also expected is a judgement for the QA team.

content.text: There are 26 HIGH-risk URS items. Next I'll map each one to its satisfying specs, design specs, and verifying test cases.

input.query:
WITH high AS (SELECT DISTINCT l.tgt_id AS urs FROM pd.val_risk_item r JOIN pd.trace_link l ON l.src_id=r.ri_id AND l.link_type='ASSESSES' WHERE r.risk_class='HIGH'),
spec_children AS (
 SELECT h.urs, l.src_id AS child, s.spec_level FROM high h JOIN pd.trace_link l ON l.tgt_id=h.urs AND l.link_type='TRACE' JOIN pd.val_spec_item s ON s.item_id=l.src_id
),
ds AS (
 SELECT c.urs, l.src_id AS child, 'DS' AS spec_level FROM spec_children c JOIN pd.trace_link l ON l.tgt_id=c.child AND l.link_type='TRACE' JOIN pd.val_spec_item s ON s.item_id=l.src_id AND s.spec_level='DS'
),
allchild AS (SELECT urs, child, spec_level FROM spec_children UNION SELECT urs, child, spec_level FROM ds)
SELECT 'URS' AS lvl, h.urs AS node, NULL::text AS spec_level, NULL::text AS link_type, h.urs AS via FROM high h
UNION ALL
SELECT 'CHILD', a.urs, a.spec_level, a.child, a.child FROM allchild a
UNION ALL
SELECT 'TC', a.urs, a.spec_level, l.src_id, a.child FROM allchild a JOIN pd.trace_link l ON l.tgt_id=a.child AND l.link_type='VERIFIES'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'TC_DIRECT', h.urs, 'URS', l.src_id, h.urs FROM high h JOIN pd.trace_link l ON l.tgt_id=h.urs AND l.link_type='VERIFIES'
ORDER BY 2,1,5;

SELECT l.src_id AS cc, l.tgt_id AS item, l.tgt_type, c.status, c.impl_dt, c.change_class, c.title FROM pd.trace_link l JOIN pd.qms_change_control c ON c.cc_no=l.src_id WHERE l.link_type='IMPACTS' ORDER BY 1;

content.text:
Three of the 26 high-risk user requirements are not currently verified under the team's definition.

1. **URS-EBR-009 (electronic batch record, control requirement): no verifying test case.** The requirement is satisfied only by CS-EBR-03, and no test case has a VERIFIES link to either URS-EBR-009 or CS-EBR-03. The requirement is therefore untested.

2. **URS-EMS-014 (EMS alarm escalation): stale verification.** Its only verifying test is TC-OQ-EMS-04 (alarm escalation to on-call, SMS and voice). The last passing execution is TX-0070 on SYS-EMS, dated 2026-01-20. CC-26-011 modified the child spec CS-EMS-03 (EMS notification group restructure, paging provider change) and was implemented on 2026-03-16. The passing run predates that change, and no re-execution exists.

3. **URS-INC-004 (door-open alarm): failed on INC-03.** The only verifying test is TC-OQ-INC-04. Its latest execution on INC-03 is TX-0023, dated 2026-02-10, with result FAIL (alarm activated at 142 s). INC-01, INC-02 and INC-04 passed. No later passing run exists on INC-03. The linked deviation DEV-26-011 is closed, but CC-26-019 (door switch replacement, which calls for re-executing TC-OQ-INC-04) is approved but not implemented, so the requirement is still unverified on that unit.

The other 23 high-risk requirements meet the verification rule. One case is worth noting: URS-ULT-001 (performance) is verified through a passing OQ re-execution on FRZ-80-02 dated 2026-04-24, after CC-26-014 was implemented on 2026-04-23. Its PQ run on FRZ-80-02 (2026-02-12) predates that change. The rule requires only one passing, post-change verifying test per unit, so I counted it as verified. Whether a PQ re-run is also expected is a judgement for the QA team.
